# oxide_external_subnets (Data Source)

Retrieve all external subnets in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_external_subnets" "example" {
  project = "my-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Name or ID of the project that contains the external subnets.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `external_subnets` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_subnets))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--external_subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_subnets`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable free-form text about the external subnet.
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the external subnet.
- `instance_id` (String) Instance ID this external subnet is attached to, if any.
- `name` (String) Unique, mutable, user-controlled identifier for the external subnet.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where this external subnet is located.
- `subnet` (String) The allocated subnet CIDR.
- `subnet_pool_id` (String) The subnet pool this external subnet was allocated from.
- `subnet_pool_member_id` (String) The subnet pool member this external subnet was allocated from.
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp when this external subnet was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp when this external subnet was last modified.
